brief:
Demonstrators gathered Saturday in the Swedish capital to protest ongoing Israeli military operations against Gaza and Lebanon, according to Shehab Wire. The rally also condemned what organizers characterized as continuing violations against Palestinian civilians. The protest drew activists and concerned residents to Stockholm's streets.

The event reflected growing international opposition to the escalating conflict in the region. Organizers used the demonstration to voice their objections to the military campaigns and to draw attention to the humanitarian situation affecting civilians caught in the violence across both territories.
